title: Wardmoor's open moor (Cairn Field/Twin Ruts/Sedge Flat/Hut Path/Peat Score, etc.) has many visually similar tiles and 'get your bearings' never actually named the two active side-quest destinations (Boot-Track Hollow for the Lost Sentry, the beacon hill for the Dark Beacon) after the first mention, so both were abandoned unfound despite real effort.
